rowNotes.gp: Non-GAAP P&L from each earnings release reconciliation (excl. intangible amortization, elective deferred comp (EDC) mark-to-market, restructuring / workforce charges, note-discount amortization, discrete tax items). Annual = sum of quarters.
rowNotes.sga: Non-GAAP SG&A / R&D = GAAP line less the EDC, amortization and workforce items booked to that line.
rowNotes.other: History = non-GAAP pretax - non-GAAP operating income (interest income net of interest expense, ex-EDC asset gains). Projections are $ inputs, rising with net cash.
rowNotes.taxR: Non-GAAP tax rate ~11-13% through FY26; 16.5% from Q1 FY27 (GMT). Malaysia 15-yr tax incentive saved $968mm in FY26.
rowNotes.sh: Diluted shares restated for the 10-for-1 split (Oct 2024). Annual = 12-month diluted count from the Q4 release.
rowNotes.epsrep: Company non-GAAP diluted EPS (quarters; pre-split values / 10). Lam doesn't publish full-year non-GAAP EPS.
rowNotes.shG: Buybacks: long-term plan returns ~85% of FCF; $3B left on the authorization after Q1 FY27.
rowNotes.cash: Cash & equivalents (FY22-23 also held $136mm / $38mm short-term investments, not included).
rowNotes.debt: Senior notes + finance leases (balance sheet). $750mm notes repaid Mar 2026.
rowNotes.ap: AP from SEC XBRL; Q1'27 not yet filed (10-Q pending).
rowNotes.dep: Quarters: D&A from release cash flow; years: 10-K D&A (XBRL).
rowNotes.amort: Intangible amortization excluded from non-GAAP (release reconciliations).
rowNotes.cx: $3B+ multi-site R&D lab build (Aug 2026), Tualatin up to $1.7B through 2041, India ~$1.2B: capex stays ~3.5-3.8% of sales.
rowNotes.nonc: Cash items excluded from non-GAAP (workforce / restructuring); EDC marks are offset by the EDC asset gains.
rowNotes.frac: Balance sheet is as of 9/27/2026 (Q1 FY27), so only Q2-Q4 of FY27 FCF is counted.
rowNotes.ebit: Stock-based comp is NOT added back (treated as a real cost).

descLines: Systems: leading-edge etch, deposition and clean tools (Kiyo, Akara, Altus, Striker, Sabre, Aether dry resist); ~70% of sales
Customer Support (CSBG): spares, services, upgrades and Reliant tools for the installed base; ~30% of sales
Q1 FY27 systems mix: memory 46% (NAND 26%, DRAM 20%), foundry 46%, logic / other 8%; China 35% of revenue
management: Douglas R. Bettinger - EVP & Chief Financial Officer
Sesha Varadarajan - Chief Operating Officer (since Mar 2026)
guidance: Q1 FY27 (Sep-26): revenue $8.22B (+54% y/y), non-GAAP GM 52.4%, op. margin 40.2% (first >40%), EPS $2.20
Q2 FY27 guide: revenue $8.6B +/- $0.4B, GM 52.5%, op. margin 40.5%, EPS $2.33 +/- $0.15, 1.253B shares
WFE: CY26 ~mid-$150B; CY27 preliminary >$200B (DRAM-led); CSBG >30% CY26, >15% CY27
Long term: GM toward mid-50s; Aether dry resist ~$2.5B by 2030; return ~85% of FCF; Investor Day (Feb 2025) 2028 targets of $25-27B revenue already exceeded
extraTakeaways: - Key risks: WFE cyclicality after an AI-driven peak, China (35% of sales; export controls), customer concentration (4 customers = 55% of FY26 sales), supply / cleanroom constraints.

sources: Earlier earnings releases (Q1 FY22 - Q3 FY26), 8-K Ex. 99.1
Q1 FY27 call highlights (WFE, tax, CSBG, GM)
methodology: Non-GAAP = Lam's basis for guidance and consensus; GAAP operating income, net income and EPS are shown alongside. Differences are small (intangible amortization, EDC marks, restructuring, discrete tax).
Fiscal year ends on the last Sunday of June (FY2026 = 6/28/2026). Q1 FY27 (Sep-26) is taken from the 10/21/2026 release; its 10-Q was not yet filed.
Segments = Systems vs Customer Support (CSBG) revenue disclosed in every release (Lam reports one operating segment). Pre-Oct-2024 share counts / EPS restated for the 10-for-1 split.
DCF: UFCF = (non-GAAP EBIT - non-core cash costs) x (1 - tax) + D&A - capex - increase in NWC; SBC treated as a cost; mid-period discounting from the valuation date.
Not investment advice. Built from public filings and press coverage.
